facts.snippet: Just because we’re older doesn’t mean that we’re wiser in all things.
facts.who: 作者/New Ground 群体（叙述用 we）
facts.did: 公开否认年长等于智慧，拒绝被当成参透人生的圣人。

facts.snippet: There is always more to learn and remaining self-aware is key to this.
facts.did: 把持续学习与自我觉察定为日常要求，警惕自己变得狭隘偏执。

facts.snippet: I’m still learning. It’s important to keep learning and to remain socially and mentally active.
facts.did: 表示自己仍在学习，并据此与同伴办艺术、法语、时事与戏剧朗读等定期活动。

facts.snippet: Diana discovered this as a mature student when she went to university to study for an art degree in her early forties.
facts.did: 四十出头以成熟学生身份进大学读艺术学位，靠同班年轻学生帮忙多过导师。

facts.snippet: Sue T used to run the equalities, diversity and inclusion group, but this was disbanded a while ago
facts.did: 曾负责平等、多元与包容小组，后主张解散，认为人人本该如此无需专组督导。

facts.snippet: There is one section of society not welcome as residents. Men.
facts.did: 经多年激烈辩论后定下男性不得入住、只可探访的规矩。

facts.snippet: Aleth read online about a young woman and her little girl who were looking for a host family
facts.did: 在网上看到一对乌克兰母女寻找寄宿家庭，先与女方会面再回社区争取同意。

facts.snippet: That ruffled some feathers because living in a community means we should discuss these things
facts.did: 未经理事共识便让 Merve 住进自家空房，承认此举引起不满。
